Status.Name: Reaction Used
Status.Description: {actor} used their reaction in round {round} for: {used}. The reaction is available again at the start of their next turn.

Track.Name: Track whose reactions?
Track.Hint: Who automatically receives the "Reaction Used" condition.
Track.Players: Player characters only (actors with a player owner)

OwnTurn.Name: Reactions on your own turn count
OwnTurn.Hint: If a feature with the "Reaction" activation is used on your own turn, the reaction counts as used as well (until the start of your next turn). Actions and bonus actions on your own turn never count.

SecondUse.Name: When the reaction is already used
SecondUse.Hint: What happens when a creature without a reaction tries to use something outside its turn again. The GM is never blocked, only warned.

HideDeath.Name: Hidden: death saves
HideDeath.Hint: All death saving throws are rolled blind: only the GM sees the result in chat.

HideSkill.Name: Hidden: {skill}
HideSkill.Hint: All {skill} checks are rolled blind: only the GM sees the result in chat.

DsnGhost.Name: Dice So Nice: ghost dice for hidden rolls
DsnGhost.Hint: Hidden rolls still show 3D dice, but faceless, so only the GM sees the result. Turns on Dice So Nice’s “ghost dice for hidden rolls” for all players (also applies to other blind rolls).

Notifications.AlreadyUsed: {name} has already used their reaction this round.
Notifications.Blocked: {name} has no reaction left until the start of their turn.

Warnings.WrongSystem: Ascandir - DnD5e Automations only works with the D&D 5e game system.
